grounding.states: first Oakville Costco is at 3471 Wyecroft Rd, near Burloak Dr
grounding.from: The new site is at 3471 Wyecroft Rd., on the edge of Burlington and Oakville. It is near Burloak Drive and the QEW.
It says demolition is done and the target opening is fall 2027.

grounding.states: Laird Rd warehouse at 3180 Laird Rd serves Mississauga and Oakville (third-party deals site, not confirmed)
grounding.from: A Costco deals site (yepsavings.com, a third-party page) describes the Laird Rd warehouse as serving Mississauga and Oakville. It gives the address as 3180 Laird Rd. This is not an official Costco source.

value.answer: Oakville doesn't have an open Costco yet. The first one is going up at 3471 Wyecroft Rd, near Burloak Dr on the Burlington border, with a target opening of fall 2027. For one that's open now, the closest I found is the Laird Rd warehouse at 3180 Laird Rd, which a deals site says serves Oakville, but I couldn't confirm its hours or how far it is from you.
